topic: Taking service calls from the bleachers on Saturday
hook_options: You're in the bleachers at your kid's game. Phone buzzes in your pocket.

We keep hearing from plumbers who haven't watched a full Saturday game in years.
How many times did you leave your kid's game to answer a price shopper?
